liveClass.title: Ya olsaydı?
liveClass.goal: Öğrenciler "ikilem kartları" çeker (sokakta para dolu bir cüzdan bulsan, en iyi arkadaşın kopya çekse...). learn.explanation:
**Second conditional**, şu an **gerçek olmayan** ya da gelecekte **pek olası olmayan** hayali durumları anlatır.

| If + **past simple** | , **would** ('d) + fiil |
|---|---|
| If I **won** the lottery, | I**'d quit** my job. |
| If I **had** more time, | I**'d learn** the piano. |
| If she **lived** near the sea, | she**'d swim** every day. |

Geçmiş zaman kullanılır ama **anlam geçmiş değildir**: hayali bir şimdiki ya da gelecek durum.

**Olumsuz:** would not → **wouldn't**

- If I didn't have a car, I **wouldn't** go to work so easily.

**Soru:** **What would** you **do if** you **won** a million?

**Kısa cevap:** Would you ...? – Yes, I **would**. / No, I **wouldn't**.

if'li kısımda **would kullanılmaz**: ~~If I would win~~

lessons.title: Senin yerinde olsam
lessons.goal: If I were you ile tavsiye verebilir, were kullanımını öğrenebilirim.

discover.title: Okur mektubu: Ne yapmalıyım?
discover.body:
Dear Ask Ayla,

A company in another city has offered me a great job. The salary is much better, but my girlfriend doesn't want to move. She has a good job here, and all her family is here too. I really don't know what to do. What would you do?

Emre, 29


Dear Emre,

That's a hard situation. If I were you, I'd talk to her honestly before you make any decision. If the new job were only for a year or two, maybe she would agree. You could also ask the company about working from home some days. If I were in your shoes, I wouldn't say yes to the job until you've found a plan together.

Ayla

questions.explanation: "A company in another city has offered me a great job."

questions.prompt: What is Ayla's first piece of advice?

learn.explanation:
Second conditional'da **be** fiili için tüm kişilerde **were** kullanılabilir. Özellikle **If I were you** kalıbı sabittir.

| Kalıp | Örnek |
|---|---|
| If I **were** you, I'd ... | If I were you, I'd take the job. |
| If I **were** in your shoes, I'd ... | If I were in your shoes, I'd say no. |
| If he **were** taller, ... | If he were taller, he'd play basketball. |

Günlük dilde **If I / he / she was** de sık duyulur, ama **If I were you** kalıbı hep were ile kullanılır.

**Tavsiye vermenin diğer yolları:**

- **You could** ask your boss. (Seçenek önerme)
- **Why don't you** talk to her?
- **I wouldn't** do that **if I were you**.

**Tavsiye istemek:**

- **What would you do** (if you were me)?
- **What should I do?**

learn.explanation:
| First conditional | Second conditional |
|---|---|
| **Gerçekçi**, olabilir | **Hayali**, pek olası değil ya da gerçek dışı |
| If + present, **will** | If + past, **would** |
| If I **pass**, I**'ll go** to Italy. | If I **had** a million, I**'d go** to Japan. |
| If it **rains**, we**'ll stay** in. | If I **were** a bird, I**'d fly**. |

**Aynı durum, farklı ihtimal:**

- If I **get** the job, I**'ll buy** a car. (İş görüşmem iyi geçti, büyük ihtimalle alırım.)
- If I **got** the job, I**'d buy** a car. (Pek ihtimal vermiyorum.)

**Kendinize sorun:** Bu olabilir mi? **Evet** → first. **Pek değil / imkânsız** → second.

lessons.title: Sen ne yapardın?
lessons.goal: Ahlaki ikilemleri tartışabilir, would / could / might ile seçeneklerimi anlatabilirim.

discover.title: Anket: Sen ne yapardın?
discover.body:
We asked 500 people three difficult questions. Here are the results.

1. If you found a wallet with 5,000 lira in the street, what would you do?
72% said they would take it to the police. 18% said they might keep some of the money. 10% said they would keep it all.

2. If your best friend cheated in an exam, would you tell the teacher?
Only 15% said yes. Most people said they would talk to their friend first.

3. If you could read people's minds, would you do it?
61% said no. As one person said: "If I knew what everyone thought about me, I'd never leave the house!"

questions.prompt: What would most people do with the wallet?
questions.explanation: "72% said they would take it to the police."

questions.prompt: Would most people like to read minds?

learn.explanation:
Second conditional'ın sonuç kısmında would dışında başka modallar da kullanılabilir:

| Modal | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **would** | kesin hayali sonuç | I**'d** take it to the police. |
| **might** | belki | I **might** keep some of the money. |
| **could** | yapabilirdim (olanak) | If I had a car, I **could** drive you home. |

**if kısmında could:** = was/were able to

- **If I could** read minds, I'd know the truth. (Okuyabilseydim)

**Fikir sormak ve tartışmak:**

- **Would you** tell the teacher? – **It depends.** / I'm not sure.
- **I'd probably** ... / **I don't think I'd** ...
- **I'd rather** + fiil: I'd rather talk to my friend first. (… tercih ederdim)

learn.explanation:
**Hayalleri anlatmak:**

- **My dream is to** + fiil: My dream is to run a restaurant.
- **I've always dreamed of** + -ing: I've always dreamed of living abroad.
- **I'd love to** + fiil: I'd love to learn to sail.
- **Imagine** + hayali durum: Imagine you had no job. What would you do?

**Hayal (second) → gerçekçi adım (first):**

| Hayal | Adım |
|---|---|
| If I **had** more experience, I**'d feel** more confident. | If I **take** a course, I**'ll learn** a lot. |
| If I **spoke** perfect English, I**'d work** abroad. | If I **practise** every day, I**'ll improve**. |

**Engelleri anlatmak:**

- **What's stopping me is** ...
- **The problem is that** ...
- **I'm not ready yet**, but ...

questions.modelAnswer: If I could do anything for a year, I'd travel around the world. First, I'd go to South America. I'd love to see Machu Picchu and the Amazon. Then I might spend a few months in Asia. If I had enough time, I'd learn to cook Thai food in Bangkok. I'd also volunteer for a charity, because I'd like to help people too. I don't think I'd stay away for a whole year, but six months would be amazing.
